run_gen_build_yaml: run the script to generate a YAML build config for the RE2 C library
review_gen_build_yaml: review the script that collects RE2 source and header files into a YAML build descriptor
refactor_gen_build_yaml: refactor the script to use Python 3 syntax and pathlib instead of os.chdir and glob

test_gen_build_yaml: test the script to verify it produces valid YAML with correct RE2 file paths
